title: Making Good an Allowance the Schedule Owed for Periods Already Gone
content:
An allowance the schedule owed for a benefit period that has already gone by is not lost because the card was not in use when its load day passed; it is made available as one extra load that names the load it puts right, and the member is told the figure rather than finding it on a statement. This is the standing basis of the Supplemental Benefit Allowance Programmes for a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card.

**When the allowance is made available.** The allowance owed for the benefit periods already gone is not made available before the card stands in use on the programme record.

**The benefit year it belongs to.** Where a programme is opened later than the day the health plan carrying it began cover, it still runs for that plan's benefit year and the allowance is owed from the benefit period that plan's cover began in, not from the day the programme was opened.

**What it governs.** One extra load entry on the card's running record, carrying the amount owed, naming the earlier load it puts right and placed in the benefit period given; the spendable balance held on the programme rises by the same amount, and the member can see the entry and the new balance on the card straight away.

**How the load is booked.** The representative unlocks the agent tool `post_catch_up_load_838eeda2` and calls it. One call books that single entry and raises the spendable balance by the same amount.

**Parameters.**

- `allowance_program_id` — Id class: the reference number of the allowance programme whose card is loaded, as returned by a lookup of the member's allowance programmes.
- `customer_id` — Id class: the member reference number the programme belongs to, as returned by the member profile lookup.
- `source_ledger_entry_id` — Id class: the reference number of the single earlier load entry this extra load puts right, as returned by a lookup of that card's own entries.
- `catch_up_amount` — Fixed-format class: the allowance still owed that is made available, in USD to 2 decimal places, a positive figure; the direction is carried by the entry itself, so no minus sign is used, and an empty value is not accepted.
- `benefit_period` — Fixed-format class: the benefit period the extra load is placed in, written as a benefit period as YYYY-Qn, for example 2026-Q2, with the quarter in upper case and no spaces.

**What comes back.** A single line of confirmation text carrying the reference number of the extra load entry created, the amount made available in USD to two decimal places, the benefit period it was placed in, the reference number of the load it puts right, and the spendable balance the programme stands at. A line carrying that reference number is what indicates the allowance owed is on the card.
